repos_data.description: Booking.com MCP server by HasData: search stays and read full property details, as JSON.
Cash-vs-award travel search MCP — hotels, flights, and rental cars across every major loyalty program, with cents-per-point valuations, loyalty tracking, and direct booking.
Google Hotels MCP server by HasData: hotel and vacation-rental search with nightly and total rates, price comparisons, ratings and amenities, as JSON.

Remote MCP server for hotel and flight search on MAQAMI (3M+ hotels). Search live rates, read hotel details, then send the customer a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co. Streamable HTTP, no API key.
MCP server for CuddlyNest — search hotels and read live rooms, prices, availability and cancellation policies from the public listing page
